passages.summary: The sage comes to Ayodhya; the king receives him and offers him what he asks.
The sage states his need and names the two rakshasas and their master.
The king is stunned, pleads his son's youth and his own late fatherhood, offers himself and his army, and refuses.
The sage's anger; Vasistha counsels the king.
The king yields. The boys are given the vidyas and set out.
The first night on the road; the confluence.
The road south; the wood is described.
The sage tells the history of the wood.
